title: Resolve purchase lines to items on exact description match
summary: Inbound purchase invoice lines now resolve to items when the description exactly matches one existing item, instead of falling through to G/L account matching.
key_points: Adds deterministic item matching by description for e-document import
Only triggers when exactly one non-blocked item with matching description and compatible unit of measure exists
Runs after item reference and text-to-account mapping steps to preserve explicit setup
Ambiguous cases retain previous G/L account matching behavior
quote: Resolves the line to the item when there is exactly one eligible item with that description.
